crossRefs.note: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
translations.bsb: Now it pleased the Lord that Solomon had made this request.
translations.kjv: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
translations.asv: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
